function formResetCase(variant) {
 const checks={},f=document.createElement('form'),other=document.createElement('form');f.id='reset-'+variant;document.body.append(f,other);
 const input=document.createElement('input'),area=document.createElement('textarea'),box=document.createElement('input');box.type='checkbox';input.defaultValue='default';area.defaultValue='line\ntext';box.defaultChecked=true;f.append(input,area,box);input.value='dirty';area.value='changed';box.checked=false;box.indeterminate=true;
 let events=0,changes=0,observed=false,flags=false;f.addEventListener('input',()=>changes++);f.addEventListener('change',()=>changes++);const inspect=e=>{events++;observed=input.value==='dirty'&&!box.checked;flags=e.target===f&&e.isTrusted&&e.bubbles&&e.cancelable&&!e.composed};f.addEventListener('reset',inspect);
 checks.result=f.reset()===undefined;checks.beforeState=observed;checks.eventFlags=flags;checks.text=input.value==='default'&&area.value==='line\ntext';checks.checked=box.checked;checks.indeterminate=box.indeterminate;checks.noChanges=events===1&&changes===0;f.removeEventListener('reset',inspect);
 input.defaultValue='later';area.defaultValue='later area';box.defaultChecked=false;checks.cleanFlags=input.value==='later'&&area.value==='later area'&&!box.checked;
 const a=document.createElement('input'),b=document.createElement('input');a.type=b.type='radio';a.name=b.name='group';f.append(a,b);a.defaultChecked=b.defaultChecked=true;a.checked=true;f.reset();checks.radios=!a.checked&&b.checked;a.defaultChecked=true;checks.radioDeselectedDirty=!a.checked&&b.checked;a.defaultChecked=false;a.defaultChecked=true;checks.radioDeselectedRemoval=!a.checked&&b.checked;b.defaultChecked=false;checks.radioSelectedClean=!b.checked;b.defaultChecked=true;
 const external=document.createElement('input');external.defaultValue='external';external.value='changed';external.setAttribute('form',f.id);document.body.append(external);f.reset();checks.external=external.value==='external';
 input.value='cancelled';const cancel=e=>e.preventDefault();f.addEventListener('reset',cancel);f.reset();checks.cancel=input.value==='cancelled';f.removeEventListener('reset',cancel);
 let calls=0;const nested=()=>{calls++;f.reset()};f.addEventListener('reset',nested);f.reset();checks.reentrant=calls===1&&input.value==='later';f.removeEventListener('reset',nested);
 input.value='removed';external.value='moved';const added=document.createElement('textarea');added.defaultValue='new default';added.value='new dirty';const mutate=()=>{input.remove();external.setAttribute('form','missing');f.append(added);area.defaultValue='listener'};f.addEventListener('reset',mutate);f.reset();f.removeEventListener('reset',mutate);checks.removed=input.value==='removed';checks.changedOwner=external.value==='moved';checks.added=added.value==='new default';checks.listenerDefaults=area.value==='listener';
 const inner=document.createElement('form'),nestedInput=document.createElement('input');nestedInput.defaultValue='nested';nestedInput.value='keep';inner.append(nestedInput);f.append(inner);f.reset();checks.nested=nestedInput.value==='keep';inner.reset();checks.nestedOwn=nestedInput.value==='nested';
 const hidden=document.createElement('input');hidden.type='hidden';hidden.defaultValue='initial';hidden.value='reflected';f.append(hidden);f.reset();checks.defaultMode=hidden.value==='reflected'&&hidden.defaultValue==='reflected';
 const style=document.createElement('style');style.textContent='.reset-box{background-color:rgb(1,2,3)}.reset-box:checked{background-color:rgb(4,5,6)}';document.head.append(style);box.className='reset-box';box.indeterminate=false;box.defaultChecked=true;box.checked=false;const before=getComputedStyle(box).backgroundColor;f.reset();checks.css=before==='rgb(1, 2, 3)'&&getComputedStyle(box).backgroundColor==='rgb(4, 5, 6)';style.remove();
 f.remove();area.value='detached';f.reset();checks.detached=area.value==='listener';
 const throws=fn=>{try{fn();return false}catch(e){return e instanceof TypeError}};checks.receiver=throws(()=>HTMLFormElement.prototype.reset.call({}));const d=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLFormElement.prototype,'reset');checks.descriptor=d.enumerable&&d.configurable&&d.writable&&d.value.length===0;
 f.remove();other.remove();external.remove();return checks;
}
